reviewPolicy: All three alchemical poison afflictions from the Howl of the Wild alchemical-items poison section are published. Ordinary saves, stages, conditions, damage, onset, maximum duration, injury delivery, and inhaled/ingested delivery metadata use Affliction Forge 0.1.61. Sportlebore Capsule remains an intentional manual exception for its auxiliary basic save, forced Stage 3 to Stage 1 cycle, second-cycle damage doubling, and magic-only condition-recovery rule.

GM Note: Stage 1 and Stage 2 conditions plus Stage 3 Enfeebled 2 are automated. Stage 3 additionally requires a DC 23 basic Fortitude save against 4d6 bludgeoning damage; after Stage 3 return to Stage 1, and double that damage if Stage 3 is reached a second time. Enfeebled and Sickened from this poison can only be recovered from by magic. These special rules remain manual.
